span.span: Periodically ran Docker container built with Rust that interacts with a CKAN instance's API to download dataset metadata and construct JSON-LD for Geoconnex-compatible datasets. These datasets are added as dataset-oriented web resources to the Geoconnex knowledge graph. Future iterations should also allow for location-oriented web resources.
